opening.text: I have pain that came on fairly quickly. It feels tender and stabbing, like a knife, and I'd rate it a 3 out of 10. Lately I've lost my appetite or I get full sooner than usual. I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe, and I've been coughing up blood. I smoke cigarettes.
